MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Encore felt like the strongest next choice because Broadway songs and vocal collaborations connect directly with what I enjoyed about Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Partners and To Be Loved appealed to my interest in expressive singing and familiar vocal standards; It's the Girls! also interested me, though I would want to sample it first."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas selections connect with my past listening, but I am not looking for seasonal music right now.",
    "In The Lonely Hour does not fit my current interest in theatrical vocals and orchestral music, while How Great Is Our God suggests a worship focus I am not seeking.",
    "I cannot judge whether The Very Best Of suits me without knowing the artist; the title alone gives me no musical connection to follow."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My previous Christmas listening seems to have been taken as a continuing desire for several more holiday albums.",
    "An interest in vocal music seems to have been stretched too broadly: having prominent singing does not make every album match the theatrical or crossover qualities I want."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between Stages, A Musical Affair, and Broadway collaborations matters more to me right now than a broad resemblance to other vocal albums.",
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music also points toward an orchestral, calmer listening mood that these recommendations only partly address.",
    "My Christmas albums were part of my past listening, rather than clear evidence of what I want on this visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my taste for expressive vocal performances but leaned too heavily on past Christmas listening and too loosely on vocal music in general."
}
